name: Ken
source:
Ken promised Dog Head that he would repay the debt with the money he earned by having his daughter work at "141".
However, he did not keep up with the repayment amount, and Dog Head almost worked him over.
He asked Francis for help and was punished by Yvet instead.
After that, he became Kerosene's subordinate and cooperated in the kidnapping of Johnny.
After Johnny's release, he participated in the invasion of the Lao Pao's Fortress Mansion on behalf of Kerosene, who was sick in bed.
He was once kissed on the cheek by Yvet.
